summary: Iteration 22, frontend only, 390x844. Flow: TRUCK2026 -> skip onboarding -> 'Take me to Pilot Travel Center Lodi CA'. ROUTE-TO-ENTRY: PASS. (a) Real flow: the parking check is cached and the backend's first route already ends at E, so route-to-entry 'Route ends at truck entrance' appears with route-summary at about 2.6s, and no /api/route reroute is called (correct). (b) Forced reroute path: I intercepted /api/agent and moved the route end about 420 m off E. route-summary showed with route-to-entry ABSENT (thumb and E present). Then /api/route fired and route-to-entry appeared about 370 ms later. (c) No E spot: I stripped 'entry' from the parking and agent responses. route-to-entry never appeared and no reroute call was made. WHEEL ZOOM: PASS. Wheel -100 over the E marker went z17->18 with E fixed within 0.1 px. Wheel +100 went z18->17 with E fixed within 0.1 px. Wheel -40 did not zoom (100 px accumulator works). Wheel +100 at an off-centre empty point (60,120) moved E to exactly the expected focal-scaled position (210.5,199.1 vs expected 210.6,199.1). The page scroll stayed at 0. PINCH: FAIL on the FIRST pinch after opening the modal. Pinching out over E went z17->18, but E jumped +844 px in y (dE = 0.1, 844.1). After a forced relayout (viewport resize) the pinch is exact: over E dE = 0.1/0.1 both ways, and off-centre at (80,450) the E position matched the expected value exactly. Also, a pinch on the map triggers native browser page pinch-zoom (visualViewport.scale went to 4) unless touch-action:none is injected. REGRESSION PASS: touch drag gave exactly -100/-80. The zoom-in/out buttons zoom about the centre. Footer 'Tap to close' and the X both close the modal. No console errors or warnings.

ui_bugs.issue: On the first pinch after the modal opens, the focal point is off by the full screen height (844 px in y), so the map zooms around a point far below the fingers. Cause: origin.current is set only in onLayout via measureInWindow, which runs while the Modal (animationType='slide', ParkingStatus.tsx:126) is still translated off-screen (y about 844). It is never re-measured, so the pinch midpoint (pageY - origin.y) is wrong. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/ParkingSatMap.tsx:54,113-114

A two-finger pinch on the map also triggers the browser's own page pinch-zoom (visualViewport.scale went 1->4 in Chromium touch emulation), because the map/pan View has no touch-action:none and the viewport meta allows scaling. On mobile Safari/Chrome the whole page will zoom along with the map. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/ParkingSatMap.tsx:183

action_items: ParkingSatMap.tsx: measure the map origin when the pinch starts, not in onLayout. For example, in the `if (!pinch)` branch read `(rootRef.current as unknown as HTMLElement).getBoundingClientRect()` (web) and use r.left/r.top in place of origin.current. Or re-measure in onPanResponderGrant. Alternatively use locationX/locationY of the touches.
ParkingSatMap.tsx: add touchAction: 'none' (web style) to the root or panHandlers View so the browser doesn't pinch-zoom or scroll the page while the user pinches the map.
critical_code_review_comments: zoomTo math (keep screen point fixed through project/unproject) is correct. Wheel and post-relayout pinch tests were exact to 0.1 px.
The wheel handler uses getBoundingClientRect at event time, so it is immune to the slide animation. The pinch path should do the same.

route-to-entry: CopilotSheet.tsx:155-165 shows the row only when entrySpot(parking) exists and routeEndsAt(route, E) is within 40 m. index.tsx:291 reroutes only if the route does not already end at E. Both are correct.

To test the reroute path, use page.route on **/api/agent?speak=true and append a point about 0.003 deg off the end of route.geometry. For pinch, use CDP Emulation.setTouchEmulationEnabled + Input.dispatchTouchEvent, and read positions with getBoundingClientRect via evaluate. Do the FIRST pinch right after opening the modal (no viewport resize, since a resize re-measures the origin and hides the bug). Check window.visualViewport.scale stays at 1. The E marker is parking-sat-spot-entry-0, and its centre equals its world point.
rca_of_issue: Pinch focal bug. Repro: open the modal, wait 2s, pinch out centred on the E marker. E moves (0.1, +844) px. Resizing the viewport triggers onLayout after the animation, which makes the error 0.1 px, confirming the stale origin. Root cause: measureInWindow runs in the first onLayout while the RN Modal slide-in transform still offsets the content by the screen height. Mitigation: compute the origin at gesture start (getBoundingClientRect on web).
